items.prompt: `assign #5 y = a;` is flagged mainly because…
choices: procedural/continuous delays are not synthesizable RTL
5 is an illegal number in Verilog
assign is not allowed in modules
items.explain: Hash-delay is simulation timing; synthesis tools cannot map it to gates.

items.prompt: Inside `always_ff @(posedge clk)`, flop outputs should use…
items.explain: Non-blocking assignment in clocked blocks models register behavior correctly.

items.prompt: `always @(*) if (en) y = d;` with no else often triggers…
items.explain: When en is low, y is not assigned on every path, so tools may infer a latch.

items.prompt: This teaching linter is identical to Vivado or Yosys synthesis checks.
items.explain: It is a lab-oriented rule pack on the HDL AST — useful for learning categories, not a full industrial sign-off tool.
